_comment: cq-v1 Connection Quality constants — the cross-runtime SSOT. The composite pair-strength math (network map, route finder, cross-pair leaderboard ordering) is specified in docs/CONNECTION_QUALITY_SPEC.md and implemented as twins in arena/mt_eval_harness/connection_quality.py (Python) and cli/website/src/utils/connectionQuality.mjs (JS). Both twins READ their constants from this file so there is ONE authority for the numbers — change a value HERE, never in a twin. The functions stay in each twin (they can't be JSON); only the constants live here. Floats are written with an explicit .0 so Python round-trips them as float. UNKNOWN weights (W_CONTAM_UNKNOWN = W_CONTAM.MEDIUM, W_TRUST_UNKNOWN = W_TRUST.unverified) are DERIVED in code, never stored, to avoid a second source. Parity is enforced by arena/tests/test_connection_quality_ssot.py and cli/test/connection-quality-ssot.test.js (both wired into scripts/ssot_parity_gate.sh).
